description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' provides a wrapper around Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface to facilitate logging within a chain of log nodes. It forwards log messages and exceptions to the Android Log and potentially to subsequent nodes in the logging chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface, to enable flexible and chained logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message to Android's log, optionally appending a Throwable's stack trace, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
